summary: Iter13 tested bugfixes (worker-version-gate, OOM guard on /api/optimizer/equity, DynamicResult empty-state, Discovery indicator visibility) + features (rule-variants gating, dynamic-verwaltung settings/refresh/log, learning summary, auto-watcher _due unit). 14/14 pytest passed. Frontend UI verified: opt-mode-discovery shows 14 opt-ind-* chips, opt-mode-dynamic hides them, dyn-rule-variants checkbox reveals INDIKATOREN FÜR DIE REGEL-VARIANTEN section, dyn-panel-toggle opens seed 'AutoTest Dyn' card with dyn-auto-check-*, dyn-interval-*, dyn-auto-apply-*, dyn-log-* + dyn-log-body-* all rendering. One UI bug found: LearningPanel is imported in Optimizer.js but never rendered anywhere in the tree - learning-toggle button does NOT exist in DOM.

ui_bugs.issue: LearningPanel is imported at line 12 but never used - no <LearningPanel /> anywhere in JSX. As a result data-testid='learning-toggle' never appears in the DOM although the user story explicitly requires it in the Optimizer.

issues: Legacy warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> (already noted in iter12).

action_items: Optimizer.js: actually render <LearningPanel /> (e.g., next to the history/dynamic-panel toggles) so data-testid='learning-toggle' and 'learning-body' become interactable. Currently imported but unused - dead code.
critical_code_review_comments: Optimizer.js keeps growing (>1260 lines) - splitting DynamicSection, ModeCards, LearningSection into subcomponents would help maintainability.
worker_supports_dynamic() cleanly guards outdated workers (409) - good separation from worker_online (503). Consider adding a version string to the 409 detail so users know the required version.
OOM RAM-Guard uses simple heuristic (days>120 or days*symbols>900). Reasonable; alternative would be a candle-count estimation, but current thresholds match test payloads.
learning_memory writes are best-effort (try/except) - good; but consider TTL index to prevent unbounded growth.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% - all core selectors present except learning-toggle (bug)

seed_data_creation: Only ephemeral fake_big + fake_dyn Mongo docs inserted and immediately deleted inside their tests. AutoTest Dyn (dyn_a6311aa5) left intact as instructed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Env has a REAL local worker connected (Anton-PC, version 1.3.0) reachable via /api/localworker/status. Therefore POST /api/optimizer/run with execution:'local' returns 200 (not 503) - unit test for worker_supports_dynamic() and worker_online() logic still covers the gate. The seeded dynamic strategy 'AutoTest Dyn' (id dyn_a6311aa5) has auto_check_enabled=true with 1 switch-log entry - reused for read-only tests. Fake optimizer_runs docs are auto-cleaned. Regarding full dynamic optimizer run (2-4 min, rule_variants) - not executed to save time; the run pipeline itself was already verified in iter12; iter13 focused on new gates/guards/UI.
rca of the issue: LearningPanel bug: The main agent added LearningPanel.js and imported it in Optimizer.js but forgot to place <LearningPanel /> in the JSX. Fix: insert <LearningPanel /> alongside the DynamicPanel toggle (~near line 810-830 where history/dynamic panels are rendered).
